aboutPage.meta.description: HatchGrab makes practical software for food trucks and mobile catering: online orders, collection times, fewer repeated questions. Founded by Dominic Bonini.
aboutPage.meta.title: About us — HatchGrab
aboutPage.story.build: We make practical software especially for food truck and mobile catering businesses — helping them take online orders, manage collection times, keep orders flowing smoothly and spend less time on repeated questions.
aboutPage.story.change: HatchGrab was created to change that.
aboutPage.story.fixedAddress: Yet most of the software available to them is designed for businesses with a fixed address.
aboutPage.story.focus: Our focus is simple: make running a food truck easier, with tools designed around how these businesses really work.
aboutPage.story.start: HatchGrab started with a simple observation: food truck businesses need better tools to run.
aboutPage.story.villageFoodie: After creating Village Foodie, a directory that helps people find food trucks coming to their area, I spent more time learning about the challenges mobile food businesses face. Unlike traditional restaurants, food trucks are always moving, working in different places and serving customers under changing conditions.

comparison.faq.capacityA: Customers only see collection times your kitchen can actually meet. The system works from each dish’s preparation time and how many you prepare at a time.

comparison.faq.paymentsA: Customers pay online by card, Apple Pay or Google Pay, or pay at the food truck. PayPal and Klarna are not supported at present.

comparison.faq.whatA: An ordering system takes orders online before customers arrive at the food truck: they choose dishes and a collection time, pay online or when they collect, and the order appears in your kitchen. A POS system or card machine takes payments at the food truck. The two complement each other.

featuresPage.detail.accountant_reports: Sales, tax and refunds for any month, quarter or tax year — ready to download for your accountant.
featuresPage.detail.advance_preordering: Let customers order for a future date or time before the event.
featuresPage.detail.auto_accept: Online orders are accepted automatically — no need to confirm them one by one.
featuresPage.detail.branded_qr_code: Add your logo to your QR code.
featuresPage.detail.buzzer_tracking: Give the order the buzzer number when you hand out a buzzer, so you know which buzzer is for which order.
featuresPage.detail.customer_display: A screen customers can see, showing order numbers and when they are ready.
featuresPage.detail.discovery_map_listin: Your food truck appears on the public HatchGrab map so nearby customers can find you.
featuresPage.detail.documents_reminders: Keep your certificates, such as food hygiene, insurance and gas safety, in one place. We remind you before anything expires, and you can send them to an event or market organiser with one tap.
featuresPage.detail.embed_schedule: Show your upcoming dates on your own website. Each one links straight to its ordering page.
featuresPage.detail.event_types: Create your own event types with custom prices and settings for events and festivals.
featuresPage.detail.kitchen_app: The fullest way to use HatchGrab: a live kitchen screen (KDS), and the only way to keep taking orders when signal is lost.
featuresPage.detail.kitchen_capacity: Set how much your kitchen can cook at a time and how long it takes. Once a time slot is full, customers cannot choose it.
featuresPage.detail.loyalty_stamp_cards: Reward returning customers with digital loyalty stamp cards — collecting stamps and giving rewards is automatic.
featuresPage.detail.meal_deals_upsells: Combine items into meal deals, and suggest extra items when the order is being finished to raise the average order value.
featuresPage.detail.messenger_instagram_: Like WhatsApp auto-replies, for Messenger and Instagram enquiries.
featuresPage.detail.multi_device_kitchen: Run several screens — front counter and kitchen — all showing the same live orders.
featuresPage.detail.multi_user_access: Give staff their own logins with the right access level.
featuresPage.detail.offline_protection: If signal is lost, online orders stop so customers cannot place orders you won’t see. The iPhone, iPad and Android app lets you keep taking orders offline; the web dashboard needs a connection.
featuresPage.detail.online_payments: Take card payment in advance through Stripe when customers order online.
featuresPage.detail.preorder_deadline: Set a deadline for items that need advance notice.
featuresPage.detail.private_events: Add private events that don’t show on the map, with their own private ordering link and QR code.
featuresPage.detail.profit_per_event: Add what each dish costs you and see the profit you really made at every event, not only your income.
featuresPage.detail.qr_code: A printable QR code that opens your menu and ordering page.
featuresPage.detail.schedule_import: We fill in your schedule automatically — from your website, or from a photo you already post on Facebook. All you do is review and confirm.
featuresPage.detail.sms_order_alerts: Send customers an SMS automatically when their order is ready.
featuresPage.detail.social_media_posts: Upload your designs — we add your dates, places and times for every week and event automatically.
featuresPage.detail.sold_out_toggle: Mark any item sold out with one tap — customers see it greyed out straight away.
featuresPage.detail.stock_countdown: Set a stock quantity; it goes down as orders arrive and finally sells out automatically.
featuresPage.detail.tap_to_pay: Take card payments on a supported phone, so no separate card machine is needed.
featuresPage.detail.ticket_printing: Print order tickets to a Bluetooth or wired printer in the kitchen.
featuresPage.detail.time_slot_selection: Customers choose a collection time slot; that spreads demand across your service.
featuresPage.detail.walkup_orders: Take and manage orders at the food truck; payments on your own card machine.
featuresPage.detail.web_dashboard: Run your service from the browser of any phone, tablet or laptop.
featuresPage.detail.whatsapp_auto_replie: Reply automatically to WhatsApp enquiries about your menu and schedule.

landing.does.devicesBody: Works on the phone in your apron, the tablet on the counter, the laptop in the vehicle — and also on the card machine you already take payments on.
landing.does.lede: Most ordering systems assume there is a fixed address, a reliable internet connection and the same hours every week. You are somewhere new every week, at different times, with weak or no mobile signal at all. HatchGrab was made for that.
